# nowwhat

> nowwhat (https://nowwhat.today) is a free one-page overview of what is happening in the world right now, in English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi and Arabic. It ranks the top 5 world news stories by how many of 11 major outlets cover them, adds a neutral 2-sentence AI summary, and shows global stock market heatmaps, top iPhone/Android apps, most-read Wikipedia articles and prediction-market odds. News, odds and the summary refresh every 30 seconds.

## Pages
- [Live front page (English)](https://nowwhat.today/): top 5 stories, AI summary of the moment, markets, trends
- [中文](https://nowwhat.today/zh/) · [Español](https://nowwhat.today/es/) · [हिन्दी](https://nowwhat.today/hi/) · [العربية](https://nowwhat.today/ar/)
- [Daily archive](https://nowwhat.today/day/): one page per day (UTC) with the day's AI summary and its biggest stories, e.g. https://nowwhat.today/day/2026-11-21
- [RSS feed of daily summaries](https://nowwhat.today/feed.xml)
- [About & FAQ](https://nowwhat.today/about)

## Machine-readable data
- [Live JSON](https://nowwhat.today/api/live): current top stories (with source URLs and outlet counts), AI summary with translations, prediction-market odds. Refreshed every 30 seconds.
- [Hourly JSON](https://nowwhat.today/data.json): top apps (iPhone + Android), most-read Wikipedia articles.

## How stories are ranked
Headlines are pulled from the public RSS feeds of BBC, Al Jazeera, The New York Times, The Guardian, NPR, DW, CNBC, France 24, Sky News, CBS and ABC. A story ranks higher the more of these outlets run it at the same time. Every headline links to the original publisher.

## Notes for citing
- The summary is AI-written (Anthropic Claude) from the headlines only; cite the linked publisher for facts.
- Non-English text is machine-translated.
- Market data is provided by TradingView widgets and may be delayed. Nothing here is financial advice.
- Contact: hello@nowwhat.today
